description: Delete an application that was never submitted (suggested, on the list, or a failure confirmed before submitting). Submitted ones cannot be deleted; use abandon_job_application. Deletion cannot be undone; tell the user what will be deleted and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope job_applications:write.)
